entities.summary: James K. A. Guthrie is an English recording engineer and record producer best known for his work with the progressive rock band Pink Floyd serving as a producer and engineer for the band since 1978. He is the owner and operator of das boot recording in Lake Tahoe, California. He is married to Melissa Kathryn (Braun) Guthrie and owns two cats, Bert & Jack.
